explanation: A city in Moab that was conquered by the Israelites and given to the tribe of Reuben as part of their inheritance.
An area east of the Jordan, known for its fertility and rich pastures; conquered by the Israelites under Moses' leadership.
The king of Bashan who was defeated by the Israelites under Moses' leadership; his defeat symbolizes God's power and protection of His people.
Another name for Mount Hermon, a high mountain in the Anti-Lebanon range, which formed part of the boundary between Canaan and other regions.
A term referring to the land and resources that God gave to the Israelites after their departure from Egypt; this includes the territories distributed among the twelve tribes.
